metadata.question: Was the area of forest cover between the Ucayali and Genepanshea Rivers larger along UC-105, at 5 km radius around center (-9.799994, -73.845369), on August 21, 2022 than on August 23, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 as primary (S2 SR for 2022, S2 L1C fallback for 2017), within ±15 days around each date; if no images, expand to ±45 days; if still none, fallback to Landsat 8/9 L2 within ±30 then ±60 days. AOI is a 5 km radius around point (-9.799994, -73.845369). 2. Masking strategy: For S2 SR use SCL to mask clouds/shadows; for S2 L1C use QA60 bits; for Landsat L2 use QA_PIXEL bits. Compute NDVI; forest = NDVI > 0.7. Cloud% approximated as 1 - validArea/regionArea. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: If collection size is 0 after all fallbacks -> C1. If validArea == 0 after masking -> C2. If any area result is null/NaN or invalid -> C3. Otherwise compare forest areas; 2022 > 2017 => A, else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Helpers const getInfoAsync = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject)); // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const center = ee.Geometry.Point([-73.845369, -9.799994]); const region = center.buffer(5000); // 5 km radius const dateA = '2017-08-23'; const dateB = '2022-08-21'; const forestNdviThresh = 0.7; // 2. Masking and dataset helpers function maskS2SR(img) { const scl = img.select('SCL'); const mask = scl.neq(0).and(scl.neq(1)).and(scl.neq(3)) .and(scl.neq(7)).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)); return img.updateMask(mask); } function maskS2L1C(img) { const qa = img.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(mask); } function scaleMaskLandsatL2(img) { const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // Dilated cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // Cirrus .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // Cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // Cloud shadow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // Snow const optical = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7']) .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return img.addBands(optical, null, true).updateMask(mask); } function getCollectionAttempt(dateStr, days, type) { const start = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(-days, 'day'); const end = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(days + 1, 'day'); if (type === 'S2_SR') { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(start, end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); } else if (type === 'S2_L1C') { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(start, end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); } else { // LANDSAT_L2 const lc8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(region).filterDate(start, end); const lc9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(region).filterDate(start, end); return lc8.merge(lc9); } } async function pickBestCollection(dateStr) { const attempts = [ {type: 'S2_SR', days: 15}, {type: 'S2_SR', days: 45}, {type: 'S2_L1C', days: 15}, {type: 'S2_L1C', days: 45}, {type: 'LANDSAT_L2', days: 30}, {type: 'LANDSAT_L2', days: 60}, ]; for (let att of attempts) { const col = getCollectionAttempt(dateStr, att.days, att.type); const size = await getInfoAsync(col.size()); if (size > 0) return {col, used: att.type, days: att.days, size}; } return {col: null, used: null, days: null, size: 0}; } function ndviComposite(col, used) { let ndviCol; if (used === 'S2_SR') { ndviCol = col.map(maskS2SR).map(function(img) { const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8','B4']).rename('ndvi'); return ndvi.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()); }); } else if (used === 'S2_L1C') { ndviCol = col.map(maskS2L1C).map(function(img) { const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8','B4']).rename('ndvi'); return ndvi.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()); }); } else { // LANDSAT_L2 ndviCol = col.map(scaleMaskLandsatL2).map(function(img) { const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5','SR_B4']).rename('ndvi'); return ndvi.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()); }); } return ndviCol.median().rename('ndvi'); } async function computeStatsForDate(dateStr) { const pick = await pickBestCollection(dateStr); if (!pick.col) return {status: 'C1'}; const ndviImg = ndviComposite(pick.col, pick.used); const ones = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('ones'); const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const validArea = ones.updateMask(ndviImg.mask()).multiply(pixelArea) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ones'); const forestArea = ones.updateMask(ndviImg.gt(forestNdviThresh)).multiply(pixelArea) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ones'); const validAreaM2 = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(validArea)); const forestAreaM2 = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(forestArea)); const regAreaM2 = await getInfoAsync(region.area(1)); if (validAreaM2 === null || forestAreaM2 === null || regAreaM2 === null) return {status: 'C3'}; const valid0 = (validAreaM2 <= 0); if (valid0) return { status: 'C2', used: pick.used, days: pick.days, size: pick.size, validAreaM2: 0, forestAreaM2: 0, regAreaM2 }; // Basic sanity: forest cannot exceed valid area by large margin; clamp for safety const forestClamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(forestAreaM2, regAreaM2)); const cloudPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 * (1 - validAreaM2 / regAreaM2))); return { status: 'OK', used: pick.used, days: pick.days, size: pick.size, validAreaM2, forestAreaM2: forestClamped, regAreaM2, cloudPct }; } try { const regionAreaM2 = await getInfoAsync(region.area(1)); console.log(`Region_km2: ${(regionAreaM2 / 1e6).toFixed(2)}`); const statsA = await computeStatsForDate(dateA); if (statsA.status === 'C1') { console.log(`2017-08-23: No images found (after fallbacks).`); console.log('C1'); return; } if (statsA.status === 'C2') { const cp = 100 * (1 - (statsA.validAreaM2 / statsA.regAreaM2)); console.log(`2017-08-23 -> Used:${statsA.used} win:${statsA.days}d imgs:${statsA.size} valid_km2:0.00 cloud%:${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, cp)).toFixed(1)} forest_km2:0.00`); console.log('C2'); return; } if (statsA.status === 'C3') { console.log(`2017-08-23: Calculation failure.`); console.log('C3'); return; } const statsB = await computeStatsForDate(dateB); if (statsB.status === 'C1') { console.log(`2022-08-21: No images found (after fallbacks).`); console.log('C1'); return; } if (statsB.status === 'C2') { const cp = 100 * (1 - (statsB.validAreaM2 / statsB.regAreaM2)); console.log(`2022-08-21 -> Used:${statsB.used} win:${statsB.days}d imgs:${statsB.size} valid_km2:0.00 cloud%:${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, cp)).toFixed(1)} forest_km2:0.00`); console.log('C2'); return; } if (statsB.status === 'C3') { console.log(`2022-08-21: Calculation failure.`); console.log('C3'); return; } // Print concise stats console.log(`${dateA} -> Used:${statsA.used} win:${statsA.days}d imgs:${statsA.size} valid_km2:${(statsA.validAreaM2/1e6).toFixed(2)} cloud%:${statsA.cloudPct.toFixed(1)} forest_km2:${(statsA.forestAreaM2/1e6).toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`${dateB} -> Used:${statsB.used} win:${statsB.days}d imgs:${statsB.size} valid_km2:${(statsB.validAreaM2/1e6).toFixed(2)} cloud%:${statsB.cloudPct.toFixed(1)} forest_km2:${(statsB.forestAreaM2/1e6).toFixed(2)}`); // Validate numbers are finite const fA = statsA.forestAreaM2, fB = statsB.forestAreaM2; if (!isFinite(fA) || !isFinite(fB)) { console.log('C3'); return; } const deltaKm2 = (fB - fA) / 1e6; console.log(`Delta_forest_km2: ${deltaKm2.toFixed(2)}`); if (fB > fA) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (e) { console.log(`Error: ${e}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
